title: TCG Pokémon
description: Digital trading card game with a Spring Boot engine and an Angular client.
evidence: Modeled game state as snapshots in PostgreSQL with Flyway migrations and pushed moves to clients over STOMP/WebSocket.

title: SkinGraph
description: CS2 skin market intelligence backed by a Neo4j graph.
evidence: Modeled skins, traders and risk cycles in Neo4j, exposed Next.js Route Handlers and documented the graph model and Cypher queries.
